title: Ikwo language
description: Igboid language spoken in Ebonyi state, Nigeria
extract: Ikwo is an Igboid language spoken in Ebonyi state in Nigeria. It forms a dialect cluster with closely related Izii, Ezza, and Mgbo, though they are only marginally mutually intelligible.
